activation_status: owner-approved experimental replay oracle; no merge gate active
durable_recovery: A subscriber can miss or receive live durable frames out of order. Reconnection from its last confirmed cursor must replay the complete exclusive durable suffix in persisted sequence order, with the same events as REST history. Transient frames and open streaming items have no durable cursor.

scenarios.requirement: A real run reaches the scripted provider and persists its final result. Full session replay equals REST history; reconnect returns the complete exclusive durable suffix. After another message, reconnect from the last confirmed cursor recovers every committed event in persisted sequence order. Live delivery may omit or reorder frames. Socket error frames have no durable cursor and are absent from replay. Transient frames and open streaming items have no durable cursor.

After independently controlled process restart with preserved storage, REST history and session replay retain exactly the same durable events and sequence positions. After another message, reconnect from the last confirmed cursor recovers every committed event in persisted sequence order and full replay still equals REST history. Live delivery may omit or reorder frames.

The separate legacy /sockets/events endpoint with resend_mode=all returns the persisted events as unwrapped events. This is a transport smoke check, not released TypeScript/OpenHands application conformance.
